title: Affine base-change chart coefficient h-map transport before cohomology
statement: Let f:X -> S and g:S prime -> S be arbitrary scheme morphisms, F a module on X, I its injective resolution, J a resolution of G=tensorPullback(g prime)F, V and W affine opens of S and S prime, W <= g inverse V, and D the flat base-change open choices. Assume the supplied Gamma(S,V)-algebra structure on Gamma(S prime,W) has algebraMap equal to g.appLE. Put h=(f restricted over V) followed by V.toSpecGamma, N the ordinary pullback of F to f inverse V, T=baseChangedScheme(h), A=baseChangedModule(h,N), U=g prime inverse(f inverse V), L=f prime inverse W, M=G restricted to L, and k=(f prime restricted over W) followed by W.toSpecGamma. This statement is independent of any cohomology degree. Put j:L -> U the open inclusion, c the canonical restriction composition isomorphism, r the restriction adjunction unit followed by pushforward(c), q:U -> f inverse V the restricted g prime, and alpha the restriction/pullback comparison. There is a scheme isomorphism sigma:L -> T and adjoint coefficient maps phi:A -> sigma_* M and psi:M -> sigma_inverse_* A. Their composites, transported along the pushforward composition and inverse-identity comparisons, are the identity coefficient maps. Phi intertwines the scalar endomorphisms from the displayed structure maps to Spec Gamma(W). The composite sigma followed by baseChangeFst equals j followed by q. Along this equality, alpha followed by the baseChangeUnit and the pushforward of phi equals D.psi followed by the pushforward of r, with the pushforward composition comparisons. These are identities of sheaves of modules, without any cohomology assertion.

source.place: 02KH first paragraph affine-local chart dictionary; 0096 pullback adjunction; 0097 composition; coefficient unit square from FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices.

proof.text: Apply Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE to the original pullback square, using L=U intersect inverse-image(W) since L<=U. Transport the restricted square by hV.isoSpec and hW.isoSpec. toSpecGamma_SpecMap_appLE and hAlgebra give the lower affine map. isoPullback gives sigma and both projection equations; map_resLE gives ef.

Construct b by undoing the restriction/pullback comparison and the pushforward comparisons from the restricted D.psi map. Define phi as the inverse adjunction hom-equivalence applied to b. The fixed-chart unit-adjoint isomorphism lemma proves IsIso phi.

Construct psi by the inverse pushforward identity and composition comparisons followed by pushforward(sigma.inv) of phi inverse. Prove the two reciprocal equations by functoriality and naturality on sections, including cancellation of the equality transports. The second chart projection equation on global sections and pushforward_map_smulHom give scalar compatibility via smulHom_naturality. The adjunction apply_symm_apply equation gives the unit square after cancelling the comparison isomorphisms. No further tensor-pullback composition lemma is needed.

proof_origin.place: 0096 adjunction and 0097 composition, with 02KH affine charts. Geometry, reciprocal maps, scalar square and unit square proved in Lean; only invertibility of the explicit fixed-chart adjoint is left as a new node.

theorem exists_flatBaseChange_chart_coefficient_transport
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
    [Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W)]
    (hAlgebra : algebraMap Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) = (g.appLE V W eVW).hom) :
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let T := baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h
    let A := baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N
    let G := (tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F
    let U := (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let L := (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let e : L ≤ U := by
      change (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      rw [flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V]
      exact (pullback.fst g f).preimage_mono eVW
    let M := (restrictFunctor L.ι).obj G
    let k := (pullback.fst g f).resLE W L le_rfl ≫ W.toSpecΓ
    let j := (Limits.pullback g f).homOfLE e
    let c := (restrictFunctorComp j U.ι).symm.app G ≪≫
      (restrictFunctorCongr ((Limits.pullback g f).homOfLE_ι e)).app G
    let r := (restrictAdjunction j).unit.app ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G) ≫
      (pushforward j).map c.hom
    let q := (pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) U le_rfl
    let α := ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).app F).hom
    ∃ (σ : L.toScheme ≅ T)
      (φ : A ⟶ (pushforward σ.hom).obj M)
      (ψ : M ⟶ (pushforward σ.inv).obj A),
      (φ ≫ (pushforward σ.hom).map ψ ≫ (pushforwardComp σ.inv σ.hom).hom.app A ≫
        (pushforwardCongr σ.inv_hom_id).hom.app A = (pushforwardId T).inv.app A) ∧
      (ψ ≫ (pushforward σ.inv).map φ ≫ (pushforwardComp σ.hom σ.inv).hom.app M ≫
        (pushforwardCongr σ.hom_inv_id).hom.app M =
          (pushforwardId L.toScheme).inv.app M) ∧
      (∀ a : Γ(S', W),
        A.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S', W)).inv ≫
          (baseChangeSnd (S := Γ(S', W)) h).appTop).hom a) ≫ φ =
        φ ≫ (pushforward σ.hom).map
          (M.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S', W)).inv ≫ k.appTop).hom a))) ∧
      ∃ ef : σ.hom ≫ baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h = j ≫ q,
        α ≫ baseChangeUnit (S := Γ(S', W)) h N ≫
          (pushforward (baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h)).map φ ≫
          (pushforwardComp σ.hom (baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h)).hom.app M ≫
          (pushforwardCongr ef).hom.app M =
        D.psi ≫ (pushforward q).map r ≫ (pushforwardComp j q).hom.app M
